scope: Residual pass isolation, manifest expansion, and shutdown reliability; offline tests plus read-only live status
verdict: Changes requested before manifest expansion; shutdown fix prepared for campaign-owner integration

findings.issue: DeleteFleets per-fleet failures are ignored. A STOP, completion or budget stop can return an action and power off the controller while the maintain fleet remains active.
findings.evidence: Original stop regression suite fails; patched suite passes, including a real budget-branch test and a watch failure/retry/success test.
findings.fix: stop_enforcement.patch checks Unsuccessful and requires a Successful acknowledgement for every requested fleet; all H7 shutdown paths use the checked helper. Failure raises so the watch retries instead of exiting. Foreign STOP markers and causes are preserved.

findings.issue: The controller host fetches its pinned residual manifest once. Updating freight, setup and launch does not update the existing controller's in-memory MANIFEST. It can stop all residual workers once the original rows finish, even with newly appended rows still running.
findings.evidence: probe_residual.py grows a manifest from one row to two while retaining the controller snapshot; finishing only the old row triggers all batches CERTIFIED; stopping.
findings.fix: Do not expand beneath the old controller. Coordinate a controller replacement with the new manifest and preserve accumulated spending history and orphan accounting. The host currently stores controller-state.json only locally, so replacement needs an explicit state-transfer or conservative remaining-budget procedure. Old workers/fleets also retain their original manifest pin and must be accounted for before overwriting freight.
findings.patch_status: Operational handoff finding; not changed by stop_enforcement.patch

findings.issue: Runbook still says prepared, NOT launched and suggests a $200 ceiling. Room message 53154 requests recording the operator's $300 total ceiling and no conditional release; both passes are now live.
findings.fix: Campaign owner should reconcile the runbook with the actual launch state and latest operator rulings. No publication until all leaves and covers are certified and hSeven is discharged.
